background: BayernLB is the Landesbank of Bavaria, owned by the Free State of Bavaria and the Bavarian savings banks, a wholesale and corporate lender that also owns the online retail bank DKB, funded mainly in wholesale markets and through DKB deposits.
synthesis: Ratings are high, at AA- on average across two of the three main agencies, both stable, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 12 May 2026, resting on state and savings-bank ownership. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 20.3% is in the top quarter, but leverage of 5.0% is below the peer median. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 178% in the top quarter and NSFR of 127% above the median, and CET1 has risen 1.8 points and leverage 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2024. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
